description: Read audio and video file metadata offline (music-metadata): container, codec, duration, bitrate, sample rate, bit depth, channels, lossless or not, tags (title, artist, album, year, genre, track…), embedded cover art, and per-track info (including video width/height for MP4/MKV/WebM). Formats: MP3, AAC/M4A/MP4/MOV, FLAC, WAV, AIFF, OGG/Opus/Vorbis, WebM/Matroska, WMA/ASF, APE, WavPack, DSD and more. File path (streamed, any size) or base64. Duration of VBR MP3s without a header is computed by scanning the file.

file.description: The audio or video file: a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

name: ai_media_info
title: Audio/video metadata
